fix(cession): keep the signing link, e-mail it, close signatures within a minute (#1982)

* fix(cession): keep the signing link, e-mail it, close signatures within a minute

Smoke of 17/10 on the real signature path:
- the signer's link vanished from the 2nd request on (view built without the
  envelope just read); every view now carries signers[].signingUrl from the block
- nobody sent the link: the panel e-mails it (system sender, house brand, first
  name only) on envelope creation and on an explicit resend
  (POST /assignor-identity/leads/:leadId/cession/resend); cessoes_assinatura.convite
- minute sweep for pending envelopes opened in the last 2 h (page of 20)
- the operation keeps termo.aceitoEm = the COMPLETED instant from the record,
  plus termo.envelopeId
- a term changed after the signature is `termo_alterado`; asking again opens an
  envelope for the current term; same term no longer asks for a second signature

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01DxYmqJFshaWue1ZNJ1oy3v

* fix(cession): resend records the attempt first, 503 when nothing went out; link only to the assignor

Adversarial review of #1982:
- resend writes convite.tentadoEm BEFORE asking the block (conditional write:
  the lock between replicas and clicks); the 1-min wait counts from it; at most
  5 attempts per envelope per day; nothing delivered -> 503 in pt-BR
- liveSignerOf: order AND e-mail must match when the block brings an e-mail;
  e-mail alone only when unique; trim + lowercase
- the signer's link only reaches the assignor's channel (machine token); the
  desk (JWT) never gets it, and the envelope's generic viewUrl is never a link
- only https links on the signing host are e-mailed
- every invitation send goes to the tenant's EmailLog (no body)
- definitive refusals after the signature are terminal (no endless retries);
  the desk reads the reason

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01DxYmqJFshaWue1ZNJ1oy3v

body:
fix(antecipacao): webhook subscriptions unique per tenant + re-point on 409; lien events of another tenant ignored quietly

The webhooks-engine enforces a unique subscription NAME per IAM organization (409
'Subscription name already exists'), and CREATE_WEBHOOK_SUBSCRIPTION speaks with the
platform key, so every panel tenant lands in the same organization. The W10 installer
(and the boleto/esignature ones) used fixed names: the second tenant got a 409, stored
subscriptionId null and its antecipacao-trava-baas never received a lien event (staging
smoke, 19/10).

- CREATE_WEBHOOK_SUBSCRIPTION `scopeToTenant`: name gets ` · <tenantId>` (stable, <=100
  chars); a 409 means the tenant's own subscription: found by name and re-pointed (PATCH
  endpointUrl, eventFilters, x-webhook-secret), real id returned; other refusals fail loud
  instead of writing an empty id. Enabled on the 3 W10 subscriptions, boleto and esignature.
- ENSURE_TENANT_WEBHOOK_SUBSCRIPTION: name scoped per tenant; TenantWebhookSubscriptionService
  re-points on 409 only when the name carries THIS tenant (never touches another tenant's).
- antecipacao-trava-baas reads the proposal in this tenant (lerProposta) and credit-lien-apply
  returns REFERENCIA_DE_OUTRO without alert when there is no operation AND no proposal; the
  OPERACAO_AUSENTE alert stays for this tenant's proposal without operation.

fix(workflows): P6 review — unique step names, no layout loop, resume never restarts a flow

- replaceDefinition refuses a definition with an unnamed or repeated step before any write, and consumes each old
  step once matched; a kept step keeps the house's on/off. calculateNodeLevels stops with WorkflowGraphCycleError on
  a self-loop or reachable cycle instead of spinning at 100% CPU. Catalogue guard: every template names its steps
  uniquely.
- In-flight check counts a `running` execution resumed from a wait state in the last 24 h (its startedAt is the
  original one), and only LIVE wait states (execution suspended, deadline not >10 min gone).
- resumeExecution reads steps/layout and writes `running` under the shared definition lock; a waited step that is
  no longer active fails the execution with a clear error instead of slice(0) re-running from step 1.
- No swallowed query inside the lock transaction; the shared-lock transaction gets maxWait 15 s / timeout 40 s.
- Schedule (cron) jobs re-synced on this replica after the switch commits.

title: fix(webhooks): 409 sem scopeToTenant só reaproveita com prova de dono
body:
fix(webhooks): 409 sem scopeToTenant só reaproveita com prova de dono

Sem a flag todo tenant fala com a chave da plataforma e cai na mesma
organização do webhooks-engine. A conciliação do 409 aceitava como dona a
inscrição de mesmo nome com descrição igual (a mesma para todo mundo que
usa o mesmo modelo) ou no mesmo host (todo webhook mora no host do
painel): o PATCH trocava endereço e x-webhook-secret da inscrição de A
pelos de B e o resume a religava — B passava a receber os eventos de A.

Prova de dono agora: endereço EXATO (o webhook de gatilho leva slug de
128 bits, único no painel) E os mesmos cabeçalhos que a inscrição guarda
(o segredo do próprio webhook; o engine devolve customHeaders na
listagem). Endereço externo pode ser comum a duas contas, o segredo não.
Sem as duas, pendência em frase clara, sem PATCH nem resume. Com a prova,
o PATCH só realinha os eventos.

No caminho com a flag, a inscrição re-apontada que volta pausada ou
desativada falha alto, em vez de sair `active: true` por padrão.

Testes: outro endereço → pendência sem escrita; mesmo nome com endereço
de outro tenant → nada muda; dois tenants, mesmo nome e mesma URL (com
segredo diferente e sem segredo) → nada muda; dona provada → PATCH só dos
eventos; re-apontada pausada → falha. Os 5 falham com o código anterior.

  notes the case on a domain refusal. Flow credito-desk-verdict in credito-base.

title: fix(antecipacao): W10 and boleto subscriptions in the TENANT's organization (ENSURE_TENANT_WEBHOOK_SUBSCRIPTION)
categories: credito | cobranca | wpp | seguranca | monetizacao | verticais
body:
fix(antecipacao): W10 and boleto subscriptions in the TENANT's organization (ENSURE_TENANT_WEBHOOK_SUBSCRIPTION)

The webhooks-engine only delivers an event to subscriptions of the event's own
organization (findActiveForEvent(organizationId, ...)). CREATE_WEBHOOK_SUBSCRIPTION
speaks with the platform key, so the W10 (Pix/TED, baas.lien.*, capture.failed) and
boleto subscriptions lived in the platform org and a tenant with its own org (operacao-saude)
never received them. Renaming alone does not fix that.

- W10 and credit-boleto-subscribe use ENSURE_TENANT_WEBHOOK_SUBSCRIPTION (tenant key,
  tenant-scoped name, found by endpoint, re-points its own on 409) and declare
  tenantBlocks ['webhooks-engine'] so the installer widens the key.
- No "already subscribed" gate before the ensure: a tenant that stored the id of a
  platform-org subscription gets its own on reinstall. The registry write sits behind
  a CONDITIONAL "id changed?" (D4 ratchet). Old platform-org subscriptions are not deleted.

- hash da VISÃO (valores, parcelas, CET, cédula) devolvido na leitura e conferido no aceite; termo divergente da
  cédula = indisponível
- contrapartes: situação "assinatura eletrônica" antes do clique, erro tipado, a Mesa não gera link
- fora de pé, só a situação (sem valores nem PDF); Pix com a mesma resposta e limite próprio (medium 5/min)
